dog.description_text:
Hi there! Macy here! Aren't I pretty? So here's the thing. I'm looking for a new family to kind of just hang out with. I am a CHILL girl. I like the occasional walk and playtime, but i'm cool with whatever my new family wants to do! I am 6 years old which is like what 42 in dog years? OMG I AM OVER 40!!! The one thing about me is that I am such a loving girl. My previous owner used to abuse me really badly until I was saved by Waldos! So as long as you promise to love me and be my best friend I would love to meet you. I've never been with cats so not sure if I like them yet, but I love dogs! I'm not sure if I would want to live with another dog, but I am friendly when I see them on the street. I don't bark and am friendly with all people. I actually love being trained and am treat motivated. I know basic commands because its always fun to get a treat after! I really enjoy meeting new people so If you want to meet me come say hi!

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs.

Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States
